cookieAuth.name: session
cookieAuth.description: The Supabase session cookie set by POST /api/auth/login. Exact cookie name(s) are managed by @supabase/ssr and vary by project; try-it-out relies on the browser's own cookie jar (same-origin fetch with credentials: "include") rather than this field.
